Step_Description: Verify the total count of items in shopping bag

Name: Validate Product Detail Page Recommendation Keyword Relevance
Precondition: User is on a Product Detail Page (Moisturizer)
Step_Description: Scroll to the PDP recommendations section ("You may also like" / "Similar products")
Expected_Result: Recommendations carousel loads with recommended product cards

Name: Validate Product Detail Page Recommendation Keyword Relevance
Precondition: User is on a Product Detail Page (Moisturizer)
Step_Description: Extract all recommended product titles from carousel
Expected_Result: List of recommended titles is extracted without nulls or duplicates

Name: Validate Product Detail Page Recommendation Keyword Relevance
Precondition: User is on a Product Detail Page (Moisturizer)
Step_Description: Tokenize and match titles against moisturizer keywords (hydrat moisture cream lotion skin face serum)
Expected_Result: At least 30% of recommended products match target keywords, passing acceptance threshold

Name: Validate Cart Page Cross-Category Recommendation Relevance
Precondition: User has moisturizer and mascara in cart
Step_Description: Navigate to the shopping bag page and view cart recommendations
Expected_Result: Cart recommendations section ("Recommended For Your Bag") is loaded

Name: Validate Cart Page Cross-Category Recommendation Relevance
Precondition: User has moisturizer and mascara in cart
Step_Description: Extract titles and match against dual-category keywords (moisturizer + mascara)
Expected_Result: At least 25% of recommendations contain keywords relevant to cart items, passing threshold

Name: Validate End-to-End Omnichannel Recommendation Consistency
Precondition: User has searched multiple products and viewed PDPs and cart
Step_Description: Collect all recommendations aggregated across PDPs and Cart page
Expected_Result: Aggregated pool of recommended products is compiled

Name: Validate End-to-End Omnichannel Recommendation Consistency
Precondition: User has searched multiple products and viewed PDPs and cart
Step_Description: Evaluate all titles against global beauty/skincare/makeup category keywords
Expected_Result: At least 20% of all aggregated recommendations belong to beauty/skincare/makeup, passing threshold

Name: Negative Test - Search with Non-Existent Product Keyword
Precondition: User is on homepage
Step_Description: Enter non-existent query "xyznonexistentbeautybrand1234" and submit
Expected_Result: Search results display 0 product cards and shows graceful no-results message

Name: Boundary Test - Search with Empty and Whitespace Strings
Precondition: User is on homepage
Step_Description: Submit search with empty string or whitespace only
Expected_Result: Search action is gracefully blocked or homepage view is maintained without crash

Name: Boundary Test - Maximum Input Length Handling in Search
Precondition: User is on homepage
Step_Description: Enter 256-character string in search input and submit
Expected_Result: Application truncates or handles input gracefully without unhandled HTTP 500 error
